'''Melore''' was one of the [[Knitting Circle|Kin Elders]] in [[Ebou Dar]] and a [[Wise Woman]].

She was very weak in the One Power, she was not strong enough to become Accepted. This means that she was below the level {{opsl|51}}. 

==Appearance==
She was plump and in her middle years.

==Activities==
Melore and seven other Elders meet [[Mat]], [[Elayne]] and [[Nynaeve]] at the [[Tarasin Palace]] to go after the [[Bowl of the Winds|Bowl]]. At the six story building the ''[[gholam]]'' kills Melore.
